requirements.title: Create study protocol draft
requirements.statement: A sponsor manager can create a Study with title, phase, indication, planned sites, and planned subjects. The system stores the protocol draft and emits an audit entry.

requirements.title: Approve protocol
requirements.statement: A protocol in draft can be approved by a regulatory officer and PI. The status transitions to approved, a ProtocolVersion is created, and downstream site activation is enabled.

requirements.title: Amend active study
requirements.statement: A sponsor manager can amend an active study. A new ProtocolVersion is created, sites are notified, and enrolled subjects are flagged for re-consent if required.

requirements.title: Milestone dashboard
requirements.statement: The dashboard shows actual vs planned milestone dates and alerts on overdue milestones.

requirements.title: Add site
requirements.statement: A sponsor manager can add a site with PI, address, and regulatory contacts. The site is created in pending status and a SiteActivationChecklist is generated.

requirements.title: Activate site
requirements.statement: A regulatory officer can activate a site once all checklist items are complete. The site status transitions to activated and an audit entry is recorded.

requirements.title: Suspend or close site
requirements.statement: A sponsor manager or safety officer can suspend or close an activated site. No new enrolments are allowed, scheduled visits are flagged, and the reason is audit-logged.

requirements.title: Monitoring visit
requirements.statement: A CRA can log a monitoring visit with findings and CAPA. The visit is linked to the site and queries may be raised.

requirements.title: Register potential subject
requirements.statement: A CRC can register a potential subject with demographics and screening data. The system checks inclusion/exclusion criteria and produces eligible, ineligible, or pending_review.

requirements.title: Enrol subject after consent
requirements.statement: An eligible subject at an activated site can be enrolled after informed consent is recorded. A unique subject number is assigned and a baseline visit is scheduled.

requirements.title: Re-consent after amendment
requirements.statement: When an amendment affects enrolled subjects, the system flags them. The CRC records re-consent with the new version; subjects not re-consented are suspended from further IP dispensing.

requirements.title: Withdraw subject
requirements.statement: An enrolled subject can withdraw consent or be discontinued by the investigator. The withdrawal reason and date are recorded, future visits are cancelled, and a withdrawal-of-consent document is generated.

requirements.title: Randomise subject
requirements.statement: The system can randomise a subject in a two-arm double-blind study to a stratified arm without revealing treatment mapping to unblinded users.

requirements.title: Schedule visit
requirements.statement: A visit scheduled from the study's visit template computes the visit window and creates an Appointment plus a SubjectVisit.

requirements.title: Record visit conduct
requirements.statement: Recording actual date, assessments, and findings transitions the SubjectVisit status to completed, missed, or early_terminated, and auto-flags deviations outside the visit window.

requirements.title: Flag missed visits
requirements.statement: A nightly task flags scheduled visits that pass window_max_date without occurrence, raises a missed-visit alert, and creates a ProtocolDeviation if required.

requirements.title: CRA verification
requirements.statement: A CRA can mark a visit's key data points as verified or query-raised. The query is linked to the subject and visit, and the monitoring status is updated.

requirements.title: Upload regulatory document
requirements.statement: A regulatory officer can upload a document with type, version, expiry, and optional site. It is stored with a DocumentReference, eTMF folder path, and audit entry.

requirements.title: eTMF dashboard
requirements.statement: The eTMF dashboard shows per-folder completeness and flags expired documents.

requirements.title: Ethics expiry alert
requirements.statement: Ethics approval expiry within 60 days raises an alert and blocks site activation if expiry passes.

requirements.title: Adverse event reporting deadline
requirements.statement: An adverse event with onset, severity, seriousness, and causality triggers computation of the regulatory reporting deadline (7- or 15-day for SUSAR), assigns a safety officer, and emits an audit entry.

requirements.title: SUSAR deadline alert
requirements.statement: A SUSAR within 24 hours of deadline or past deadline raises critical alerts to the safety officer, PI, and sponsor manager.

requirements.title: Receive IP shipment
requirements.statement: A site pharmacist can record receipt of an IP shipment with lot, expiry, quantity, and storage condition. Inventory is incremented and a receipt is audit-logged.

requirements.title: Dispense IP
requirements.statement: Dispensing IP to an enrolled subject decrements inventory, creates an IpDispense record, and notifies pharmacy-system / eps if the IP is tracked there.

requirements.title: Define budget categories
requirements.statement: A sponsor manager can define budget categories (start-up, per-subject, procedure, pass-through). The planned budget is stored and actuals accumulate from enrolment and visit events.

requirements.title: Generate invoice
requirements.statement: A finance coordinator can generate a draft invoice from actuals, route it to the sponsor, and link it to supporting events.

requirements.title: Recruitment dashboard
requirements.statement: The recruitment dashboard shows actual vs planned enrolment by site, screen-fail reasons, and dropout rates.

requirements.title: Register agentic subject
requirements.statement: An agent owner can register an AgentSubject with principal_id, persona_key, superpersona_contract_id, model_version, and AgentAttestation trust bundle. The system validates the attestation and emits an audit entry.

requirements.title: Agent consent contract
requirements.statement: An owner accepting the AgentConsentContract makes the agent eligible for enrolment in agent-in-the-loop studies.

requirements.title: Dashboard query response time
requirements.statement: The system shall return recruitment and milestone dashboard queries within 500 ms at the 95th percentile under normal load.

requirements.title: Concurrent enrolment throughput
requirements.statement: The system shall support at least 50 concurrent subject enrolments per minute without error or response-time degradation beyond 1 second.

requirements.title: OIDC JWT authentication
requirements.statement: The system shall authenticate every API request with a valid OIDC JWT and reject requests with missing, expired, or tampered tokens.

requirements.title: Role-based access control
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce role-based access control so that sponsor managers, regulatory officers, safety officers, and coordinators can only perform actions permitted by their roles.

requirements.title: Audit log durability
requirements.statement: The system shall durably record every protocol status change, site activation, subject enrolment, and adverse-event report to an append-only audit log.

requirements.title: SUSAR critical alert latency
requirements.statement: The system shall raise a critical SUSAR alert to the safety officer, PI, and sponsor manager within 60 seconds of adverse-event creation when the regulatory deadline is within 24 hours.

requirements.title: FHIR R4 export compatibility
requirements.statement: The system shall export study, site, subject, and adverse-event data as valid FHIR R4 resources for interoperability with external research platforms.

requirements.title: Configurable workflow versioning
requirements.statement: The system shall support configurable study workflow and consent versioning without requiring a code deployment for routine protocol amendments.

requirements.title: Study jurisdiction selects the country pack
requirements.statement: The system shall record a jurisdiction on every study and resolve registry format, approval authorities, statutory deadlines, consent rules and reimbursement rules from that jurisdiction's versioned country pack rather than from conditional logic.

acceptance_criteria.given: a study is created declaring a jurisdiction
acceptance_criteria.when: any policy value is resolved for it
acceptance_criteria.then: the value comes from that jurisdiction's versioned country pack

requirements.title: Public trial-registry submission and receipt
requirements.statement: The system shall submit a study to its jurisdiction's public trial registry through the BulletTrain hub and shall mark it registered only on an acknowledgement carrying a registry identifier valid for that jurisdiction, recording a rejection with its reason otherwise.

acceptance_criteria.given: a study has been submitted to its public trial registry
acceptance_criteria.when: the registry acknowledges with an identifier valid for the jurisdiction
acceptance_criteria.then: the registration becomes registered and carries the receipt reference

requirements.title: Investigator delegation log
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain a site delegation log naming the delegating principal investigator, the delegated person, the delegated tasks and the professional registration, deriving GCP training expiry from the jurisdiction's validity period.

acceptance_criteria.given: a principal investigator delegates a task at a site
acceptance_criteria.then: GCP training expiry is derived from the jurisdiction's validity period

requirements.title: Site activation readiness with explicit blockers
requirements.statement: The system shall report site activation readiness together with every blocking reason found, including incomplete checklist, absent delegation, expired GCP training and missing current ethics approval.

acceptance_criteria.given: a site has an expired GCP credential
acceptance_criteria.then: the expired credential is returned as a named blocking reason

requirements.title: Ethics and competent-authority submissions
requirements.statement: The system shall record ethics and competent-authority submissions with a recognised submission type and an authority code resolved from the jurisdiction's country pack.

acceptance_criteria.given: a submission is made to the ethics or competent authority
acceptance_criteria.then: the authority code comes from the jurisdiction's country pack

requirements.title: Named human approval decisions
requirements.statement: The system shall require a named decider for every regulatory decision, shall require at least one condition for an approval with conditions, shall reject unknown decision values and shall refuse to overwrite a terminal decision.

acceptance_criteria.given: a regulatory decision is recorded
acceptance_criteria.then: the decision is refused

requirements.title: Approval expiry and statutory report clocks
requirements.statement: The system shall record an approval expiry and the next statutory report due date computed from the country pack's annual safety-report interval.

acceptance_criteria.given: a submission is approved
acceptance_criteria.then: an approval expiry and the next statutory report date are stored

requirements.title: Approvals and statutory reports falling due
requirements.statement: The system shall report approvals expiring and statutory reports falling due within a configurable window.

acceptance_criteria.given: approvals with expiry dates and report dates exist
acceptance_criteria.when: the due report is requested for a window
acceptance_criteria.then: those falling inside the window are listed

requirements.title: Hub-mediated criteria-only pre-screen request
requirements.statement: The system shall request eligibility pre-screening through the BulletTrain hub carrying only a pseudonymous candidate reference, the criterion list and the consent basis, and shall refuse a request with no criteria.

acceptance_criteria.given: a candidate is pre-screened
acceptance_criteria.then: only a pseudonymous reference, the criteria and the consent basis leave CTMS

requirements.title: Derived eligibility outcome
requirements.statement: The system shall derive the eligibility outcome from the returned criterion verdicts, treating any failed criterion as ineligible and any unevaluable criterion as pending review, and shall refuse an evaluation that omits a requested criterion.

acceptance_criteria.given: criterion verdicts are returned
acceptance_criteria.then: the derived outcome is ineligible

requirements.title: Auditable pre-screen decisions
requirements.statement: The system shall audit-log every eligibility pre-screen outcome with the reviewing human or the source system that produced it.

acceptance_criteria.given: a pre-screen outcome is recorded
acceptance_criteria.then: an audit entry names the reviewer or source system

requirements.title: Consent lifecycle record
requirements.statement: The system shall record consent as a lifecycle event carrying its type, the protocol version consented to, who gave it, any witness and any future-use opt-in, and shall move the subject to an active consent state.

acceptance_criteria.given: a subject re-consents to an amended protocol
acceptance_criteria.then: the consent state returns to active and the protocol version is stored

requirements.title: Explicit re-consent flagging
requirements.statement: The system shall flag enrolled subjects for re-consent against an amended protocol version, moving them to a re-consent-required state and audit-logging the flagging per subject.

acceptance_criteria.given: an amendment requires re-consent
acceptance_criteria.then: each subject moves to re_consent_required and the flagging is audited

requirements.title: Withdrawal cancels future activity
requirements.statement: The system shall, on withdrawal of consent, set the subject's consent state to withdrawn, stamp the withdrawal time and scope on the consent record and cancel every scheduled visit.

acceptance_criteria.given: a subject withdraws consent
acceptance_criteria.then: scheduled visits are cancelled and the scope is stamped on the consent

requirements.title: Consent state gates investigational product
requirements.statement: The system shall refuse to dispense investigational product to a subject whose consent is withdrawn or who is pending re-consent.

acceptance_criteria.given: a subject's consent is withdrawn or pending re-consent
acceptance_criteria.when: investigational product is dispensed to them
acceptance_criteria.then: the dispense is refused as unprocessable

requirements.title: Withdrawal propagates to every downstream surface
requirements.statement: The system shall propagate a consent withdrawal through the hub to the participant surface and the dispensing surface, and shall stop presenting upcoming visits on the participant summary.

acceptance_criteria.given: a subject withdraws consent
acceptance_criteria.then: citizen-portal and pharmacy-system are both notified and the participant surface stops offering visits

requirements.title: Deterministic stratified allocation list
requirements.statement: The system shall generate a stratified permuted-block allocation list per study and stratum, deterministically from the protocol number and stratum key, so that the allocation can be reconstructed for audit.

acceptance_criteria.given: a study and stratum have no allocation list
acceptance_criteria.when: a subject of that stratum is randomised
acceptance_criteria.then: a deterministic permuted-block list is generated first

requirements.title: Allocation consumes the next free slot
requirements.statement: The system shall allocate the next free slot of the subject's stratum, record the allocating actor, write an audit entry and refuse allocation when the list is exhausted.

acceptance_criteria.given: an allocation list exists
acceptance_criteria.then: the next free slot is consumed and an audit entry is written

requirements.title: Blinded allocation read
requirements.statement: The system shall return only the kit code and stratum on the blinded allocation read, never the treatment arm.

acceptance_criteria.given: a subject has been randomised
acceptance_criteria.then: the kit code is returned and the treatment arm is not

requirements.title: Emergency unblinding with named authoriser
requirements.statement: The system shall record the requester, the named authoriser, the reason and the urgency of an emergency unblinding, and shall flag the case where requester and authoriser are the same person.

acceptance_criteria.given: an emergency unblinding is authorised
acceptance_criteria.then: the requester, the named authoriser, the reason and the arm are stored

requirements.title: Three-limb SUSAR determination
requirements.statement: The system shall determine a SUSAR from all three ICH E2A limbs -- serious, unexpected and suspected to be related to the investigational product -- while honouring an explicitly asserted SUSAR flag.

acceptance_criteria.given: a serious, unexpected, suspected-related reaction is reported
acceptance_criteria.then: it is flagged as a SUSAR

requirements.title: Country-pack statutory reporting deadline
requirements.statement: The system shall compute the statutory reporting deadline from the study's country pack and shall record the basis used, comprising pack code, pack version, classification and day count.

acceptance_criteria.given: a SUSAR is fatal or life-threatening
acceptance_criteria.then: the country pack's expedited window is applied and the basis recorded

requirements.title: Safety report submission to a recognised recipient
requirements.statement: The system shall submit a safety report only to a recipient recognised by the jurisdiction's pack, recording the submitting human and a submission reference and dispatching through the hub.

acceptance_criteria.given: a safety report is submitted
acceptance_criteria.when: the recipient is not one the jurisdiction recognises
acceptance_criteria.then: the submission is refused

requirements.title: Safety loop closes on acknowledgement
requirements.statement: The system shall close the safety reporting loop only on an acknowledgement carrying a receipt reference, shall record a rejection with its reason, and shall report submissions past their statutory deadline without acknowledgement as overdue.

acceptance_criteria.given: a safety report has been submitted
acceptance_criteria.then: the submission becomes acknowledged and stops appearing as overdue

requirements.title: Dispense cannot exceed on-hand inventory
requirements.statement: The system shall refuse a dispense that exceeds the product's on-hand quantity so that the close-out accountability identity can balance.

acceptance_criteria.given: a product has fewer units on hand than requested
acceptance_criteria.then: the dispense is refused so accountability can balance

requirements.title: CTMS-initiated dispense notifies the dispensing sibling
requirements.statement: The system shall notify the pharmacy and prescribing siblings through the BulletTrain hub for a dispense initiated in CTMS, not only for one arriving on an inbound webhook.

acceptance_criteria.given: a dispense is initiated inside CTMS
acceptance_criteria.then: the pharmacy sibling is notified through the BulletTrain hub

requirements.title: Participant summary contract
requirements.statement: The system shall expose a participant summary contract carrying study, consent state, re-consent requirement, upcoming visits, reimbursements and results availability for the citizen portal to render, while remaining the canonical owner of that state.

acceptance_criteria.given: a participant exists
acceptance_criteria.then: consent state, upcoming visits, reimbursements and results availability are returned

requirements.title: Reimbursement policy from the country pack
requirements.statement: The system shall take reimbursement currency and per-visit guidance cap from the study's country pack, flag a payment above the cap, refuse a non-positive amount and refuse an inconvenience payment in a jurisdiction that does not permit one.

acceptance_criteria.given: a payment exceeds the jurisdiction's per-visit guidance cap
acceptance_criteria.then: it is stored in the pack's currency and flagged as over the cap

requirements.title: Named approval of participant payments
requirements.statement: The system shall require a named approver for a participant payment, shall refuse a second approval and shall notify the citizen portal of every state change through the hub.

acceptance_criteria.given: a flagged payment is approved
acceptance_criteria.then: the approving human is named and a second approval is refused

requirements.title: Country policy is versioned validated data
requirements.statement: The system shall hold country policy as versioned data declaring a schema version, pack version, effective-from date and official sources, and shall fail to load a pack that omits a statutory section rather than silently removing a deadline.

acceptance_criteria.given: a country pack omits a statutory section
acceptance_criteria.then: loading fails rather than the deadline disappearing

requirements.title: Country packs exposed read-only
requirements.statement: The system shall expose the country packs read-only, individually and as a set, and shall refuse an unknown jurisdiction.

acceptance_criteria.given: an unknown jurisdiction is requested
acceptance_criteria.then: the request is refused
